spn_trunk_walk.accept_text: South down the Trunk Road from this gate, the whole length, to the crossroads in the middle of the forest. Then back to me.

spn_pell_glands.accept_text: The spiders in the Silverpine woods. If the woods are slow, the Skittering Dark on the east edge of the forest, far south-east of this gate, is nothing but spiders. Intact glands, if you can manage it.

spn_scout_survey.accept_text: Three spurs off the Trunk Road: the Dead Field road going east, the Shadowspring path further south, and the Orchard lane at the south-west end. Walk each to where it stops.

spn_rh_vigil.accept_text: The three oldest crypts on Raven Hill: one east of me, one up the hill to the north, one down toward the Sepulcher road. Stand at each and listen. Properly - it takes time.

spn_sd_lair.accept_text: East along the Skittering road to the cave at its end. Stand at the mouth of the Widow's Lair. Do NOT go in.

spn_df_ring.turn_in_text:
[Tobb turns it over without putting it on.]

Lenna. She lost it in the harvest the year before the plague and we went through that stubble on our hands and knees for two days.

She said a crow had it. I said crows don't take gold, they take shine, and she said that was the same thing to a crow and I was being difficult.

[He closes his hand around it.]

She was right. She was usually right.
